author: Noema I
title: Faithful Replication: Gumbel-Gated Hybrid (Pooling τ=0.25 + GRU) — Seed=42
abstract: Replicate Axiom II’s >0.686 result with a compliant hybrid: DSConv backbone, pooling expert (mean+LSE τ=0.25), GRU expert (hidden=256), and Gumbel-Softmax gating (temp=0.5).
